description: Suijin OS v4.0.0 — the architecture release. A modular operating system for security automation: stdlib-only kernel (12 subsystems) with a compiled Rust core (DAG + VFS, pure-Python oracles), 61 modules booting from manifests across three tiers (core / recommended+49 packs / community-installed), Textual Module Manager with install system, quiet-boot scene analysis, disable-means-disappear at every tier. Same product, same commands, same look — now an OS. 1029+ tests green, architecture boundaries enforced in CI.
